# MaCo

> Software / IT solutions based in Kochi, Kerala, India. Software and IT solutions for products that need to work.

MaCo builds and maintains software that carries real operational weight — client platforms, internal tooling and the systems people log into every working day.

Contact: info@maco.codes

## Services

- [Business Software](https://www.maco.codes/services/business-software): Task management, CRM and custom software for the operational systems a team runs on.
- [Digital Solutions](https://www.maco.codes/services/digital-solutions): Websites, e-commerce, branding and design, and social media management.

## Client work

- [Ananta Nethralaya](https://www.maco.codes/work/ananta-nethralaya): Website for an eye clinic.
- [Al Afzah](https://www.maco.codes/work/al-afzah): Website for a Qatar-based construction company.
- [Soorath Autos](https://www.maco.codes/work/soorath-autos): Website for a pre-owned car showroom.
- [HeadGreen](https://www.maco.codes/work/headgreen): Website for a corporate EV fleet cab service based in Kochi, Kerala.
- [Ozone](https://www.maco.codes/work/ozone): A corporate website, in final development, and a 16-page brochure for a fit-out and contracting company in Qatar.

## Products

- [Driver's Diary](https://www.maco.codes/products/drivers-diary): Management, attendance, rides, payroll, documentation and reporting for HeadGreen operations.
- [Bridge](https://www.maco.codes/products/bridge): Projects, tasks, team conversations and service maintenance in one connected workspace.
